elements.label: Figure 2.22
elements.description: Bar chart (single series, teal bars). Y-axis: 'Percentage point change in poverty rate', scale 0.0 to -12.0 in steps of 2. X-axis categories: 2010–2014, 2016–2020, 2010–2020. No values are printed on the bars. Approximate readings: 2010–2014 ~-5.8; 2016–2020 ~-2.8; 2010–2020 ~-11.8. The pattern: poverty fell in every period, with the largest decline over the full 2010–2020 span, roughly double the sum of the two sub-periods' declines.

elements.label: Figure 2.23
elements.description: Stacked bar chart. Y-axis: 'Point change', scale 3.0 to -15.0 in steps of 3. X-axis categories: 2010–2016, 2016–2020, 2010–2020. Legend: Rural (teal), Urban (orange), Population shift effect (gray), Interaction effect (yellow). No values are printed on the segments. Approximate readings, stacked from top: 2010–2016: interaction ~+0.3, rural ~-4.6, urban ~-0.6, population shift ~-0.6, net total ~-5.5. 2016–2020: interaction ~+0.2, rural ~-2.7, population shift ~-0.3 (urban near zero), net total ~-2.8. 2010–2020: interaction ~+0.8, rural ~-9.6, urban ~-1.6, population shift ~-1.6, net total ~-12.0. The pattern: rural areas account for most of the decline in every period, while urban contributions and the population shift effect are small, and the 2010–2020 bar is the largest.
